evaluator.name: Phase 1 deterministic validators plus browser inspection

contractChecks.evidence: One approved precedence path is consistent across source and portable guidance.
Core language, type weights, CTA actions, OG compositions, document range, Figma nodes, and sanctioned exceptions are reconciled.
Focus, placeholder, border, target-size, keyboard, lockup contrast, large-text, motion, and forced-colour contracts pass the Phase 1 gate.
Eight pages pass eight supported widths with zero horizontal overflow.
A copied release verifies its own 74 files, hashes, links, required assets, and private-path boundary.
Four assigned Figma source nodes map to exact 1600 px exports with source and export SHA-256 values.
Canvas, Figma, and the website remain candidate references rather than being over-claimed as canonical or certified.

qualityDimensions.evidence: A fresh agent has one machine-readable precedence and conflict rule.
Measured failures are corrected and protected by deterministic checks.
The complete 64-combination matrix passes with content-stress fixtures.
The copied release contains all files needed for baseline web use and validates independently.
Source nodes, hashes, decisions, tests, exceptions, context, and outputs are recorded.
Phase 1 preserves and safely repairs the current V1. Strategic identity and channel excellence remain the work of Phases 2 onward.

notes: Phase 1 is complete. This pass does not certify the current Canvas as the final visual north star.
